UTA.head: This one sets up well for Utah
UTA.body: Utah has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Toronto can make a game of it if it pounces on loose pucks.

TOR.head: Everything points away from Toronto
TOR.body: Utah has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Toronto could still pull it off if it pounces on loose pucks, but it might need a miracle.
